name: aurea-luxury-perfume-web
description: AURÉA Haute Parfumerie — Official Luxury Perfume E-Commerce Web Platform

scripts.serve: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url==='/'?'/index.html':req.url;let p=path.join(__dirname,f);fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found')}else{let ext=path.extname(p);let m={'html':'text/html','js':'application/javascript','css':'text/css','png':'image/png'}[ext.slice(1)]||'text/plain';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m});res.end(d)}})}).listen(5173,()=>console.log('Server running at http://localhost:5173'));"

author: AURÉA Haute Parfumerie Design & Engineering Team
